channel.title: FretMemo Blog
channel.description: Insights on theory, practice, and the art of the guitar.

item.title: Learn guitar improvisation step by step: 22 modules from the E string to Giant Steps
item.description: Learn guitar improvisation in 22 free modules: theory cards, quizzes, licks and backing loops in 9 styles, with an optional mic check of your target notes.

item.title: Your first 12 bar blues guitar solo: a free 14-module blues path
item.description: Learn a 12 bar blues guitar solo in 14 free modules: the form, shuffle, bends checked by your mic, licks, turnarounds, guide tones and jazz blues.

item.title: Guitar triads: inversions, string sets and voice leading in 12 modules
item.description: Learn guitar triads in 12 free modules: four qualities, inversions on four string sets, CAGED, voice leading through real progressions and triad pairs.

item.title: Shell and drop 2 voicings for jazz guitar: the seventh chords and comping path
item.description: Learn shell, drop 2 and drop 3 voicings for jazz guitar in 12 free modules, then comp ii-V-I and standards while your mic checks the top voice.

item.title: A free Guitar Pro viewer online: open .gp5, .gpx and .gp files in your browser
item.description: A free Guitar Pro viewer online: open .gp3, .gp4, .gp5, .gpx and .gp files in the browser, play them with two sound engines and export WAV.

item.title: How to practice a song on guitar by looping the bars you keep missing
item.description: How to practice a song on guitar: loop 2-4 bars, slow them down, find your weak bars with a mic score and loop those. A free browser method.

item.title: A free online guitar tab editor for the Guitar Pro files you already have
item.description: A free online guitar tab editor for Guitar Pro files: change frets, rests, durations, bars, tempo and meter, then save or download a .gp file.

item.title: A free online amp simulator with NAM amp models, in your browser
item.description: A free online amp simulator with 7 NAM amp models, a tone designer, .nam import and live input for your guitar. Runs in the browser, no account.

item.title: I Played Guitar for 8 Years Before I Actually Knew the Fretboard
item.description: A personal story about overcoming the fear of the fretboard and finally learning the notes.

item.title: The Spider Walk Is Boring. Here's How to Make It Useful.
item.description: Turn the most boring guitar exercise into a powerful fretboard learning tool with 3 levels of difficulty.

item.title: I Tried Every Fretboard App So You Don't Have To
item.description: An honest comparison of the most popular fretboard learning apps, from paid giants to free web tools.

item.title: Why the Fretboard Makes No Sense (And It's Not Your Fault)
item.description: The guitar is structurally confusing compared to other instruments. Here's why and how to deal with it.

item.title: Why Random Practice Feels Harder But Works Better
item.description: The science of interleaved practice and why struggling to find notes is actually a sign of deep learning.

item.title: No Guitar? No Problem. Practice in Your Head.
item.description: Learn how to visualize the fretboard and practice anywhere: commute, boring meetings, or before bed.

item.title: 5 Technique Exercises That Actually Make You Better
item.description: Beyond the spider walk: Permutation, String Skipping, Diagonal Patterns, Legato, and Linear shifting.

item.title: What Guitarists Actually Need From a Trainer
item.description: Why most apps fail (subscriptions, bad mics) and what a focused practice tool should actually look like.

item.title: What's Coming to FretMemo
item.description: Streaks, Heat Maps, Ear Training, PWA support, and more. The roadmap for the future of FretMemo.
